description: This is a Java test class for the FinCare project, specifically testing user loan permissions such as capitalized income, buy down fee, interest refunds, approved amount updates, and contract termination within the integration test suite.

classes.name: UserLoanPermissionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest, contains setup method and multiple test cases for loan permissions such as capitalized income, buy down fee, interest refund, approved amount update, and contract termination.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test data: creates a client, a loan product, and disburses a loan before each test.

methods.name: testCapitalizedIncomeAndCapitalizedIncomeAdjustmentPermissions
methods.description: Tests permissions related to capitalized income and its adjustment.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeAndBuyDownFeeAdjustmentPermissions
methods.description: Tests permissions for buy down fee transactions and adjustments.

methods.name: testManualInterestRefundPermission
methods.description: Tests permission required for manual interest refund transactions.

methods.name: testUpdateApprovedAmountPermission
methods.description: Verifies permission control over updating the approved amount of a loan.

methods.name: testContractTerminationAndUndoContractTerminationPermission
methods.description: Checks permissions for contract termination and undoing contract termination operations.
